# Project Description

This static educational website shares programming assignments with Mergington High School students. Students browse, view and download assignments.

## Project Structure
- `assignments/`: one folder per assignment, with README and optional starter files.
- `templates/`: reusable assignment templates.
- `assets/`: CSS, JavaScript, images and assignment detail page.
- `index.html`: portal; `config.json` registers assignments and attachments.

## Project Guidelines
- Maintain consistent styling, responsive layout and accessible semantic markup.
- Use descriptive kebab-case IDs and verify links and attachments.
- Preserve existing assignments and avoid dependencies unless justified.
- Validate JSON and JavaScript syntax and test the affected workflow.

## Educational Standards
- Use clear learning objectives and student-friendly language.
- Match difficulty to the intended students; provide measurable tasks and examples where useful.
- Keep starter code incomplete where the student is expected to implement the solution.
